title: fix(spec): a published fieldPatches label is served by every object read, not only /layers
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8Mwj3s3TJDLo1t9qXkT1euk)_

Fixes #29564

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`translateObject` 的字段 `label` 与选项 `label` 两个槽位改走既有的 `valueOverridesPackagedBase` 比较,与 `description` / `inlineHelpText` / `inlineTitle` 及对象三标量同一条规则。
- 为什么改:对象扩展发布的 `fieldPatches` 改了字段标签后,只有 `/layers` 能看到,无包名读、`?package=` 基础包读和列表读都被目录(catalog)里的出厂标签盖回去了。
- 风险与回滚:租户覆盖层对字段标签或选项标签的改名,从此也会压过目录翻译(与对象改名 #8284 同理);回滚即还原 `i18n-resolver.ts` 的两处判断。
- 先看:`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts` 的 `translateField`(两处新判断与选项基线的取法),再看 `packages/rest/src/meta-object-field-patch-i18n.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/meta-object-field-patch-i18n.test.ts`(先建 spec),预期 7/7 通过,补丁标签 `Headline` / `Queued` 在 zh-CN 与 en 两个语言下都原样返回。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`, `translateObject` → `translateField`:
  - The field `label` (catalog, then the built-in system-field label) is applied only while `valueOverridesPackagedBase(packagedField, 'label', def.label)` is false, i.e. only while the served label still equals the same field's label in `packagedBase`.
  - Each option label is applied only while it still equals the label of the packaged field's option with the same `value` (found with the existing `packagedPart` finder, matched by `String(value)` as the dashboard filter options are).
  - A picklist-bound served field (`picklist` set) is judged against no field-level baseline: its options are the list's, resolved onto the served field on every read (`resolvePicklistFieldsOnto`) and never present on the packaged declaration, so the catalog (field-level, then `picklists.LIST`) applies to them exactly as before. The registry fold never applies an option patch to a picklist-bound field either.
  - The docblock paragraph that said a field label stays a flat `catalog ?? document` now states the rule above.
- One comparison, no second application: nothing re-applies the patch after translation; the two slots ask the same predicate their siblings ask.

## Why

ADR-0146 D10 admits a base field's `label` and option `label` through an object extension's `fieldPatches`, and the registry folds the patch onto every read. The served `/meta` exit (`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`, `translateMetaDocument` / `translateMetaList`) localizes the folded body with `translateMetadataDocument('object', …)`, which wrote the catalog's field label and option labels unconditionally. The showcase catalog carries an `en` entry for every `showcase_task` field, so the shipped text replaced the patch on the bare, `?package=` and list reads (reproduced on `main` `50e35a28`, report 6588058932). The objectql pin reads registry bodies directly and never runs this localization, which is why it stayed green.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.test.ts`: new block "translateObject — a field label and its option labels yield to a diverged value" (9 cases: the patched label and option through the type dispatch in `en` and `zh-CN`; per-field and per-option judgment; untouched document; no base; absent or empty served label; a field or option the base does not declare; a picklist-bound field keeps the list's labels; an injected system field's built-in label; no input mutation). The old case "leaves FIELD labels alone — the rule is scoped to the three scalars" pinned exactly the branch this changes, so it is replaced by "judges a FIELD label by the same rule".
- `packages/rest/src/meta-object-field-patch-i18n.test.ts` (new, 7 cases): a REAL `SchemaRegistry` with an owner and a `fieldPatches` extender; the protocol double's `getPackagedObjectBase` reads the registry. It drives `translateMetaDocument` and `translateMetaList` and asserts the patched field label, patched description and patched option label in `zh-CN` and `en`, the untouched siblings still translated, and the no-extension control.

## Acceptance notes

- Side effect, by the #8284 rule: a tenant overlay's rename of a field label or option label is now served over the catalog too, the way an object rename already is.
- A field the packaged base does not declare (an extension's own field) counts as diverged on every slot, as its `description` / `inlineHelpText` slots already did. So a catalog entry for such a field's label is no longer served. In this repository no producer writes one: the i18n extractor walks `objects` only, and no generated bundle carries an extension field. Named here because a third-party bundle could.
- Not changed, noted only: `formula-option-labels.ts` (objectql) and the analytics dimension labels call `translateObject` without a `packagedBase`, so they keep applying the catalog unconditionally (no base means the rule infers nothing). Not measured to diverge on a public read.

- Option slot (the early return disabled): spec pin 2 failed / 390 passed; REST pin 4 failed / 3 passed.
